changelog: - **Write-path capability gate on the mentorship modules** (#2352, epic #2348). Hiding a module from the sidebar (#2351) is not access control — the route is still reachable by a direct POST — so this closes the actual hole: every mutating handler of a mentorship-specific module (`/api/goals`, `/api/weekly-reports`, `/api/questions`, `/api/meeting-requests` and `/api/evaluations`, POST plus the `[id]` PATCH/DELETE — twelve handlers in all) now calls `requireCapability(session.user.orgId, …)` before any write, and a tenant whose vertical does not carry the module is refused with `403 { code: 'capability_unavailable', capability }`. The gate runs before validation, so a gated vertical never even reaches the 400. The acting user's own org decides it, INTERNSHIP carries every capability, so this is a strict no-op for today's product — proven by an INTERNSHIP e2e that posts to all five and asserts none is capability-gated, alongside a MARKETING e2e that asserts all five are.
